Free e-Copy of Bayesian Computation with R (Use R)
Amazon is currently making the first edition of Bayesian Computation
with R (Use R) by Jim Albert available for free on Kindle. I own a
copy of the book and there is a lot of good content and R examples on
how one can do general Bayesian statistics. The R scripts from the
book (2nd edition but there’s a lot of overlap) can be obtained on Jim
Albert’s web site http://bayes.bgsu.edu/bcwr/

http://statistical-research.com/free-copy-of-bayesian-computation-with-r-use-r/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=free-copy-of-bayesian-computation-with-r-use-r
